x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.body: Given a user requests an enhancement, When submitted through the portal, Then it lands in the platform backlog with requester, value, effort and priority fields Given the monthly governance forum, When the backlog is reviewed, Then approved items are scheduled into a release
x_1577958_dsb_pattern_item.title: Platform enhancement and defect requests are captured, triaged and prioritised in one backlog
